migrate_models_from_yaml: run the migrate_models function to read a config.yaml and POST each model to the proxy /model/new endpoint
resolve_os_environ_placeholders: run the migrate_models function to interactively resolve os.environ placeholders in litellm_params before posting to the proxy
skip_vertex_ai_models: run the migrate_models function which automatically skips vertex_ai models during the migration process
cache_env_var_values: run the migrate_models function which caches previously entered os.environ values in memory to avoid repeated prompts
post_models_to_proxy: run the migrate_models function to send POST requests with model_name and litellm_params to the proxy base url
